items.title: Soudan: un an après la chute d’El-Fasher, une «ville fantôme» à la population brisée

Le 19 février 2026, une mission internationale indépendante d’établissement des faits mandatée par l’ONU concluait à des « signes distinctifs d’un génocide » sur place. Si, 12 mois plus tard, il est encore impossible de dresser un bilan humain, acteurs humanitaires, observateurs et rescapés s’accordent à décrire la capitale de l’État du Darfour-Nord comme une « ville fantôme ».

items.summary: arXiv:2610.31768v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Omni-modal large language models (Omni-LLMs) can jointly process a broad range of modalities, such as text, audio, and video, enabling stronger multimodal understanding and reasoning capabilities, but often at substantial inference cost. We observe that the benefit of additional modalities varies across queries, indicating that a fixed modality configuration can be inefficient. Motivated by this, we study query-wise modality selection, which keeps the underlying Omni-LLM fixed while adaptively selecting which modalities to provide for each query.

items.title: NATO FLF Battle Group-Poland celebrates Romanian Armed Forces Day with sports competition
items.summary: Romanian soldiers deployed with NATO’s Battle Group-Poland marked Romania’s Armed Forces Day with allied U.S., Croatian and British troops at Bemowo Piskie Training Area. A Romanian-led competition featured volleyball, indoor soccer and table tennis, giving soldiers a chance to build camaraderie beyond their regular duties. Romania won the soccer event, while Croatian teams took second and third. Leaders said the celebration strengthened cooperation and reflected the troops’ commitment to their mission despite being far from home.

Dans une étude récente publiée dans la revue Journal of Applied Ecology, des scientifiques du Museum national d’histoire naturelle ont démontré que l’arrêt temporaire des éoliennes pendant la nuit, période qui correspond au pic d’activités des chauves-souris, permettrait de réduire leur mortalité de plus de 80 %.

items.title: Hunebed D27 in Borger, Netherlands
items.summary: Just a short walk from the Hunebedcentrum in Borger stands D27, the largest dolmen in the Netherlands. At over 22 meters (74 feet) long and more than 5,000 years old, this megalithic monument was already ancient when Stonehenge was still centuries away. Massive boulders form the tomb, including the heaviest capstone ever used in a Dutch dolmen, estimated to weigh around 20 tons. The monument has fascinated visitors for centuries. Grotta Tanaccia is therefore considered the oldest sanctuary in the Republic of San Marino. items.summary: American television series The Pitt may have redefined the popularity of medical drama, but hospitals have always provided a rich seam for creatives, whether their medium is page or screen. From novels like Aleksandr Solzhenitsyn's 1966 Soviet-era Cancer Ward and Abraham Verghese's epic saga Cutting for Stone (2009) all the way through to television dramas such as Casualty, ER, and Grey's Anatomy, it seems we can’t get enough of human stories played out in a tense clinical setting. This is the absolute opposite of what author Chloe Aridjis does in The Shadow of the Object.

items.title: [Perspectives] Beyond the battlefield: war and global health security
items.summary: During the Syrian war (2011–24), the Assad Government forces and their Russian allies conducted hundreds of strikes on medical facilities in opposition-held areas. Monitoring groups documented over 600 attacks on health care, resulting in the deaths of hundreds of health-care workers throughout the conflict. Hospitals in eastern Aleppo and other contested regions were reduced to rubble. Surgeons operated in underground rooms illuminated by generators, and ambulances were targeted while transporting patients between sites.

items.title: [Perspectives] Temporal rationing: a man with gastric cancer in Colombia
items.summary: Pepe, a 45-year-old man living in the city of Cali, Colombia, worked as a self-employed hauler of goods with a wheelbarrow. In 2010, he presented to a general practitioner with several months of abdominal heaviness and non-exertional substernal burning. The physician provisionally diagnosed gastro-oesophageal reflux disease and prescribed omeprazole. However, Pepe's symptoms slowly worsened and 10 weeks later he returned to the physician, who ordered a gastroscopy, which occurred 2 months later, revealing an ulcerated mass.

items.title: 55.77 جنيه سعر الدولار فى بنك الإسكندرية اليوم الأحد
items.summary: استقر سعر الدولار الأمريكي مقابل الجنيه المصري اليوم الأحد 25 أكتوبر 2026، فى بنك الإسكندرية عند 55.77 جنيه للشراء و 55.87 جنيه للبيع. المصدر:اليوم السابع 55.77 جنيه سعر الدولار فى بنك الإسكندرية اليوم الأحد
